subject: Error in numeric(n) : vector size cannot be NA  - graph file?

messages.author: a9a2e3e6359d9ea1
messages.subject: Error in numeric(n) : vector size cannot be NA  - graph file?
parts:
Dear inlas,

running the next lines is well appreciated by inla

> # Unstructured      ----------------------------------------------------------
> formula =Y~f(region,model="iid")    
> result  = inla(formula,family="poisson",data=Austria1,E=E,       control.predictor = list(compute=1))  

running the following lines obviously offends inla:

#structured
> formulabym =Y~f(region.struct,model="besag",graph=gemeinde)+f(region,model="iid")
> resultbym  = inla(formulabym,family="poisson",data=Austria1,E=E,    control.predictor = list(compute=1))

Error in numeric(n) : vector size cannot be NA

As I made a new larger graph file (the old one was okay): is there an easy way to check if the graph file is the causer of this message?
or  just user incompetence?


tnx - Thomas
